items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Lola Lane was on the program, MGM was there, Mitchell Lewis and I

ctx.x: But in the end, they were playing more than they thought they were going to play. They played at the -- they come out of rehearsal with the second band. I went

and got a new band. And they come out with the second band, and they opened in the Paramount Theatre in Newark. And Lola Lane was on the program, MGM was there, Mitchell Lewis and I and when they closed that theatre, after opening over here for two days, then they said, well, they could open at the Paramount in New York.
So I didn't like that. I said, they must be favoring the girls. There ain't no bands can go open out of rehearsal with a new band and go to the Paramount in New York.
